verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer docs include an API reference with endpoint descriptions (e.g., create_campaign, create_event) and offer a Postman collection of pre-built requests plus a sandbox test account to try calls, which provides some runnable/testable experience. However, there's no evidence of an embedded interactive 'try it' console with live runnable code examples directly in the reference pages themselves. missing for 10: evidence of in-page interactive/try-it API console, embedded runnable code snippets per endpoint, independent confirmation of this interactive experience.
